featured_reviews.name: Akash Chavan
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited the Passport Seva Kendra (PSK) Vasai today for my PCC process, and I was honestly surprised by how smooth and quick the entire experience was. I was done within just 10 minutes.

The centre space is comparatively small and is attached with the India Post office, but despite that, the process was very well managed and organized.

Special thanks to Mr. Mishra Sir for the excellent service. He is extremely professional, humble, calm, and clearly knows exactly what he is doing. The best part is that he communicates fluently in Hindi, Marathi, and English, which makes the whole process very comfortable for everyone.

He asks only the exact details required and guides you properly without wasting any time. Really impressed with the efficiency and professionalism at PSK Vasai. Great experience overall.

featured_reviews.name: viraj s wadkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Worst passport office experience ever. This center is merged with the post office, and the entire place is extremely messy and dirty — shipments are lying all around, making it very unorganized.

My appointment was scheduled for 11:00 AM, and I reached half an hour early, but even at 11, the previous appointments were still pending. The process is painfully slow and poorly managed, with only two counters operating. The staff is rude, unhelpful, and completely unprofessional. When asked for basic information, they simply say, “Inquire online, we’re not here to help.”

After waiting for over 3 hours, my application was rejected without proper guidance. I immediately rescheduled my appointment at Malad, where the experience was completely different and much better.

I do not recommend the Vasai East Passport Seva Kendra to anyone. If possible, go to Thane or Malad centers instead — they are far more organized and professional.

featured_reviews.name: Aditya Das
featured_reviews.review_text:
“I had a very good experience at the Passport Seva Kendra. The officers were extremely polite, professional, and helpful throughout the entire process. They treated everyone with respect and made the procedure smooth and stress-free. I truly appreciate their excellent service and positive attitude.

The only issue was the lack of proper air conditioning. The weather was very hot and humid, and it became quite uncomfortable while waiting. I would kindly request the management to install or improve the AC facilities, as it would make a big difference to the comfort of visitors. In such weather conditions, proper air conditioning is really necessary.

Overall, I am very satisfied with the service provided by the officers and staff. Thank you for your professionalism and support.”

featured_reviews.name: Sujith Nair
featured_reviews.review_text:
Extremely disappointing experience. The staff were unnecessarily rude and impatient throughout the process. The facility itself is poorly maintained, cramped, and located inside a post office with virtually no proper waiting area or seating arrangements for customers.

What was most frustrating was the way the staff behaved towards families with children. Expecting a young child to pose perfectly on the very first attempt is unrealistic, yet the staff seemed to lose their temper immediately when our child did not cooperate exactly as instructed. Instead of showing patience and professionalism, they became visibly irritated and made the entire experience stressful and uncomfortable.

Customer service is not just about completing a task; it is about treating people with respect. Unfortunately, this place failed on both counts. I would not recommend it unless significant improvements are made to staff behavior, cleanliness, and customer facilities.

featured_reviews.name: Sushil Jadhav

featured_reviews.name: Prathamesh Rane
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently traveled with Jivdani Travels, and despite a slight delay in the bus pickup by half an hour (understandable due to the festive season), the overall experience was excellent. What impressed us the most was their proactive approach—they started taking follow-ups at least four days before the departure date. We were provided with all the necessary information, including the coordinator's contact details and the exact pickup location.

The coordinator was highly responsive and available whenever we needed assistance, which added to the smooth experience. The highlight of the trip was the live tracking link, allowing us to track the bus's real-time location, which was incredibly helpful.
